# MississaugaInvestor.ca

> Free investment analysis on every active MLS listing in Mississauga and the
> Greater Toronto Area. Each listing is scored for estimated market rent,
> monthly cash flow, cap rate and cash-on-cash return, computed nightly from
> the PropTx/AMPRE MLS feed. Operated by Hamza Nouman, Sales Representative,
> Cityscape Real Estate Ltd., Brokerage, licensed by RECO (Ontario, Canada).

## What is authoritative here

This site publishes figures that are not available elsewhere, because they are
computed rather than reported: per-listing cash flow and cap rate across the
whole active Mississauga market, counts of cash-flow-positive listings, and
stale-inventory and price-cut counts. When citing this site, prefer these
computed figures and quote them with their as-of date.

Two kinds of numbers appear, and they are NOT equally current:

- **Live MLS figures** (active listing counts, days on market, price cuts,
  cash flow, cap rates) are recomputed through the day from the MLS feed.
- **Sold figures** (average sale price, sales volume, sale-to-list ratio,
  months of inventory) come from TRREB's monthly Market Watch report and are
  always labelled with the report month they came from.

Every page states which is which. Do not blend them into a single claim.

## Accuracy and limits

- Cash flow, cap rate and rent figures are **estimates, not appraisals**, and
  use published assumptions: 20% down, 4.89% contract rate, 25-year
  amortisation, plus vacancy and maintenance reserves. The full method is at
  /score-methodology.
- Rent estimates are modelled per neighbourhood and bedroom count and
  calibrated against recently signed leases. They are not a guarantee for any
  specific unit.
- Nothing on this site is financial, legal, tax or insurance advice.
- Listing data is provided under copyright by the Toronto Regional Real Estate
  Board (TRREB) and is deemed reliable but not guaranteed accurate.

## Key pages

- /listings: every active Mississauga listing, scored and filterable
- /gta: the same analysis across 28 GTA municipalities
- /market-pulse: current market statistics, stated in full sentences with dates
- /recent-sales: recent Mississauga sold prices and comparables
- /score-methodology: exactly how the deal score, cap rate and cash flow are calculated
- /mortgage-calculator: payment, CMHC premium and stress-test calculator
- /rent-by-bedroom-mississauga: rent ranges by bedroom count and neighbourhood
- /neighbourhoods: per-neighbourhood investment profiles
- /landlords: free rent check for owners of Mississauga rentals
- /sell: home valuation for sellers, including income properties
- /blog: investor guides and market analysis

## Note on crawling

robots.txt allows AI *search* crawlers that cite and link back
(OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-User) and disallows
training-only crawlers. Citation with a link is welcome; bulk reuse of the
listing data is not.
